ELECTRICITY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.

2. When learning Electro- Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.

3. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

7. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

16. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester
